```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source("R/ecoflor_submissions.R")

contributions <- read_contributions()
sessions <- read_sessions()
orals <- contributions %>% filter(Final_format %in% TALK_FORMATS) %>% add_talk_times()
posters <- contributions %>% filter(Final_format == "Poster") %>%
  mutate(Poster_no = row_number())

talk_table <- function(talks) {
  rows <- paste0(
    "| ", talks$Time,
    " | **", md_escape(talks$Presenter, italics = FALSE), "**",
    ifelse(talks$Student, " ^S^", ""),
    " | ", ifelse(talks$Final_format == "Rising Star", "*Rising Stars talk:* ", ""),
    md_escape(talks$Title), " |"
  )
  paste(c("| Time | Speaker | Title |", "|:--|:--|:------|", rows), collapse = "\n")
}

poster_table <- function(p) {
  rows <- paste0(
    "| ", p$Poster_no,
    " | **", md_escape(p$Presenter, italics = FALSE), "**",
    ifelse(p$Student, " ^S^", ""),
    " | ", md_escape(p$Title), " |"
  )
  paste(c("| No. | Presenter | Title |", "|:--|:--|:------|", rows), collapse = "\n")
}
```

**3–6 February 2027 · Faculty of Science, Charles University · Viničná 7, Prague**

^S^ student presentation (eligible for the best student presentation award)

```{r}
#| results: asis
for (day in unique(sessions$Day)) {
  cat("\n## ", day, "\n\n", sep = "")
  for (sid in sessions$Session_ID[sessions$Day == day]) {
    s <- sessions %>% filter(Session_ID == sid)
    chair <- if (s$Chair != "") paste0(" · Chair: ", s$Chair) else ""
    cat("\n### ", s$Start_time, " · ", s$Session_Name, "\n\n", sep = "")
    if (chair != "") cat("*", sub("^ · ", "", chair), "*\n\n", sep = "")

    if (s$Type == "Poster") {
      p <- posters %>% filter(Session_ID == sid)
      if (nrow(p)) cat(poster_table(p), "\n\n")
    } else {
      t <- orals %>% filter(Session_ID == sid)
      if (nrow(t)) cat(talk_table(t), "\n\n")
    }
  }
}
```
